description: Presidential Secretariat - Award of Honorary Rank of Admiral of the fleet of Admiral W. K. J. Karannagoda (Rtd) and Honarary RanK of Marshal of the Air Force to W. D. R. M. J. Goonetileke (Rtd.) Commander of the Sri Lanka Air Force, by His Excellency the President
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively announces personnel appointments (promotions) of two named individuals (Admiral Wasantha Kumar Jayadewa Karannagoda and Air Chief Marshal Wellarachchige Don Roshan Mahesh James Goonetileke) to honorary military ranks. It contains no detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, government structural changes, or specialized administrative matters, fitting the definition of a People Gazette.
